DataTable(target, {table, columns?, limit?, onRowClick?}) - live table; columns + cell formatting derived from the descriptor; masked fields render ••••; a relation column (name ending _id) shows the related row's label (name/title/label/email/slug, as relation pickers label options) through the list API's ?include=, which applies the related table's access rules, and shows the id when the caller can't read that row; datetime cells show local date and time, date cells the stored day; refreshes on bm.live events. Returns {refresh, destroy}.

RecordForm(target, {table, id?, onSaved?}) - create (no id) / edit (id) form; renders ONLY writable fields, control per type; FK columns become relation-pickers (a <select> of the related table's rows; a current value the picker can't list stays selected as #id); submits via the typed CRUD SDK. A create starts from the column defaults; an edit starts from the row and sends ONLY the fields the person changed (an unchanged save sends nothing and calls onSaved with the row), so an untouched value is never rewritten. Values are sent as the column takes them: checkbox true/false (1/0 on an INTEGER flag), datetime as the UTC instant (the datetime-local control shows the viewer's local time), number as a number, and an emptied number/date/time/relation as null (left out on a create, so the default applies). Returns {destroy}.

WizardForm(target, {table, steps, id?, onSaved?}) - multi-step RecordForm; steps:[{title, fields:'a,b'}] declares the grouping (a UX choice the schema can't derive), controls/per-step validation/submit are still derived.
Detail(target, {table, id, children?}) - read-only record view + an embedded DataTable for each one-to-many child relation (reverse FKs, from the descriptor). Master-detail with no wiring.

FlowForm(target, {flow, params?, onResult?}) - derives a form from a flow's `inputs:` block (see api({at:'flows'})), calls bm.flows.<flow>(), auto-polls when mode: async, renders the response. enum inputs render a <select>. `flow` takes the same spellings as bm.flows ('saveQuote' or 'save-quote').
Transitions(target, {table, id, onTransition?}) - workflow state buttons from bm.workflow().available(); transitionTo on click.

Gate(target, {perm?|role?}) - hides the element unless the caller is allowed. role: any listed role (admin always passes). perm: a scope string from bm.auth.me().permissions ('contacts:delete'); that list comes from app.yaml roles: scopes and is empty for everyone, admins included, in an app that declares none. can(perm) / hasRole(role) return the same booleans.
Uploader(target, {onUpload?}) - file upload over bm.upload.

- DATA/DISPLAY - DataTable also takes {perPage, search, sortable, paginate} (server-side ?sort/?order/?q/offset). Cards(target,{table,title?,subtitle?,badge?,onCardClick?}); Board(target,{table,groupBy,groups?,onMove?}) drag-to-PATCH kanban; Stat(target,{table?|aggregate?|value?, where?, label?, format?}); Chart(target,{type,table,groupBy,value?:'count'|'sum:col'|data}).

- PRIMITIVES - Modal/Drawer({title?,content,onClose?})→{close,el}; Tabs/Accordion(target,{tabs|items}); Toast(msg,{type,action?}); Dropdown/Tooltip(target,opts). Atoms returning HTML strings: Badge(text,{variant}), Avatar({name|src,size}), Spinner, Skeleton, ProgressBar(value,{max,label}).
- AUTH - Login/Signup/Forgot/Reset(target,opts); ProfileForm; MfaSetup; OAuthConnect({providers?}); SessionManager; ApiTokenManager; ActAs (admin). All over /api/_auth/*.

- GOVERNANCE - VersionHistory({table,id}); AuditLog({table?,row_id?,…}); RecordLock({table,id}); ShareDialog({table,id}) (bm.permissions); DownloadMyData (the signed-in user's own data from GET /api/_my-data → JSON; see my_data).
- FILES - SignedImage({path,ttl?}); PdfButton({page,label?}); MediaGallery({table,urlField?,captionField?}).
- WORKFLOW/JOBS - FlowButton({flow,body?,confirm?}) async-aware; WorkflowBadge({table,id}) colored state; JobStatus({jobId}); JobsDashboard.
- REALTIME - NotificationBell (bm.notifications, live); Presence({slug}); Chat({table,bodyField?}); CommentThread({table,where,bodyField?}); ActivityFeed({table,titleField?}).
- OPS - Dashboard({stats:[StatOpts],charts:[ChartOpts]}); UsageMeter (GET /api/_usage); WebhookManager (GET/POST/DELETE /api/_webhooks).

- QUERY LAYER (POST /api/_query - scoped + column-validated) - query(spec); QueryView({table,select?,where?,order_by?}); Report({table,group_by,aggregates,chart?}); PivotTable({table,rows,cols,value?}); SavedViews({spec?,onSelect?}).
- RELATIONS - MultiRelation({table:joinTable,parentField,parentId,childTable,childField}) M2M editor; TreeView({table,parentField?,onSelect?}) self-ref hierarchy.

- SCHEDULING/APPROVALS - Reminder({table?,rowId?}) (POST /api/_scheduled, a 30s sweeper fires due reminders into notifications); ScheduleAction({flow,body?}) runs a flow at a future time; Approval({table,id}) request→approve/reject (/api/_approvals); the requester types the approver's email into the form.
